title: Passé composé guide
why_en: Use the passé composé for a completed event viewed as a whole.
formation_en: Build it with a present-tense auxiliary (avoir or être) plus the main verb’s past participle.
common_mistakes: Do not use the infinitive after the auxiliary.
With être, the past participle can agree with the subject.

title: Futur proche guide
why_en: Use the futur proche for an intended, imminent, or strongly expected future action.
formation_en: Conjugate aller in the present, then add the main verb in the infinitive.
common_mistakes: Keep the main verb in the infinitive.

title: Negation guide
why_en: Use ne … pas to make a statement negative.
formation_en: Place ne before the conjugated verb and pas after it.
common_mistakes: In writing, keep ne even though it is often dropped in informal speech.

title: Reflexive construction guide
why_en: Use a reflexive pronoun when the action returns to the subject.
formation_en: Put me, te, se, nous, vous, or se before the conjugated verb.
common_mistakes: Match the reflexive pronoun to the subject.

title: Subordinate clause guide
why_en: Use que to introduce a clause that depends on another idea.
formation_en: Place que before the subject and verb of the dependent clause.
common_mistakes: Do not treat que as a standalone vocabulary item in this structure.
